svg.title: Cascading Dice Table — clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: A full polyhedral dice cascade—d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, and d100—falling onto a gamer table. Click a numbered region to toggle its suggested color. Shift-click paints every region with the same number.
